subject.title: [codex] Add Even Hub glasses bootstrap identity

question: Should core Gateway recognize `openclaw-even-g2-node` with signed `platform: "even-hub"` and `deviceFamily: "glasses"` as a canonical native setup-code bootstrap client that receives the bounded operator handoff?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and tested, but the choice changes a Gateway auth trust boundary and creates a durable wire-level identity for an external glasses app; automation cannot choose that product/security contract.

options.title: Approve identity after rebase
options.body: Accept the proposed client id and signed metadata contract, require conflict resolution, and preserve the spoof/metadata-upgrade tests before merge.

options.title: Rename before merge
options.body: Ask the contributor to switch to the maintainer-preferred durable Even Hub identity and refresh the external app proof before merging.

options.title: Keep external for now
options.body: Defer the core bootstrap identity and keep the broader integration discussion on the related product-direction issue.

recommendation.title: Approve identity after rebase
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed client id and signed metadata contract, require conflict resolution, and preserve the spoof/metadata-upgrade tests before merge.
